risks.risk: Lens fungus/haze/scratches may exist but are not clearly visible in the current photos, affecting image quality and resale value.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens front and rear glass with flashlight (and ideally a test shot of a high-contrast scene).
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens condition unknown (worst case: treat as needing cleaning or with possible haze/fungus).

risks.risk: Camera may have hidden faults (sensor dust, autofocus issues, shutter/battery door issues) despite seller claim.
risks.proof: Power-on video showing: screen on, autofocus/live view working, and a taken photo displayed on the camera.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified working (worst case: assume basic operation may be unreliable).

risks.risk: Shutter count claim may be inaccurate or not verifiable.
risks.proof: Screenshot/readout from a shutter-count tool or in-camera/utility showing shutter count.
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher shutter count (worst case for value).

risks.risk: Accessories may be missing or not original (2 batteries/charger/case).
risks.proof: Photos of all included items laid out: both batteries with labels, charger, and the silicone case.
risks.if_unproven: Price as camera only (worst case: no extra batteries/case/charger).

risks.risk: Exact lens model and condition are not confirmed; wrong lens model changes pricing.
risks.proof: Photo showing the lens name/model ring text clearly (and lens front/rear glass close-ups).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown lens (worst case: lower value).

proof_requests: Send new photos (or short videos) that show: (1) lens front and rear glass close-ups with flashlight, (2) camera power-on with screen display and a taken photo shown, (3) shutter count screenshot/readout, (4) all included items laid out: 2 batteries, charger, silicone case, (5) lens model text clearly.
response.reason: The seller’s reply is not supported by new evidence. Without power-on/test proof, shutter count readout, lens glass close-ups, and photos of included accessories, the item cannot be priced confidently beyond worst-case assumptions.
